A one-line Dependabot major bump of astral-sh/setup-uv in the CI workflow; if the new major broke, CI would fail loudly and block merges rather than pass anything wrongly.
A one-line Dependabot major bump of actions/checkout in the CI workflow; a bad version fails the required check loudly and changes no harness decision.

kill_group and _group_gone now refuse pgid <= 1 and alive() treats an overflowing pid as dead; wrong, the first signals every process the user owns via kill(-1) and the second lets a second lander take over a live lander's lock.
Test-only: pins the ADR date in the index test so the expected literal stays fixed; it changes no production behaviour.

land.sh now runs git merge --abort in the human's main checkout when merging origin/main into local main conflicts; wrong, this reconciliation cleanup leaves main mid-merge or resets state in the person's own working tree.

verify_commit_landed now shlex-parses the command and resolves which repository a commit ran in (cd, -C, -c); a wrong match judges the commit against the wrong HEAD, so a false 'landed' claim passes or a real one is blocked.

Moves every non-Claude rule into AGENTS.md, makes CLAUDE.md an @AGENTS.md import, points Gemini at it and adds new prose rules; a broken import or dropped line would silently remove governance rules (ORCH, Rule 11) from what each runtime loads, though no hook changes.

Adds Codex role definitions with sandbox modes for reviewers and engineers, reviewer agents whose verdicts gate merges, and new model_router deny-table entries; wrong, a reviewer gets write authority or a mis-tiered Agent call is allowed or denied.

Adds jev.py, which sets the consequence tier from glob floors plus external-model probabilities and redacts secrets before sending repository metadata to an external API, and test_plan.py, which turns that tier into the checks run; wrong, it under-tiers a change so High checks are skipped, or leaks a secret.

Replaces input cloning in both provision and land with harness_inputs.copy_inputs (secret-path denial, tracked-file exclusion by path and inode) and adds content fingerprints to readonly_guard; wrong, the gate tests bytes other than the candidate, credentials reach a specimen, or a reviewer's edit goes undetected.

Adds task_loop.py, which takes labelled issues, runs a worker and runs gh pr merge to main with no person in the loop, gated only by green checks; wrong, it publishes unreviewed changes to the integration branch in place of the owner's merge decision.

The mutation runner now fingerprints modes, links and ancestors and refuses results from an unrestored specimen, and the mapped-test hook resolves which repository it trusts and blocks on an incomplete run; wrong, false mutation kills enter the ledger or another repository's code runs as a test.

Rewrites when the task loop merges to main unattended versus holding for the owner (base-branch tiers, protected paths, check-list parsing, --match-head-commit, untrusted issue text); wrong, a High-tier or gate-changing PR merges with no human.

Rewrites the lsof predicate that decides whether land.sh force-removes (or rm -rf's) a stale lander worktree and whether worktree_status prunes one; wrong, a worktree a live process is working in is deleted.

kill_group now reaps the gate's leader while waiting so its process group reads as gone on lander stop and timeout; wrong, gate processes linger after the lander exits or cleanup stalls, a bounded process-cleanup effect.
Changes lsof -w to +w in the worktree-deletion predicate; extra warnings can only add output, which keeps a worktree, so the worst a wrong flag can do is let stale worktrees pile up.

Replaces tier gating with a hard-coded docs allowlist for unattended merges and pins the base commit used for lint, the diff and ignore rules; wrong, a code or gate change merges to main with no human.

Narrows the unattended-merge allowlist to docs/** and README.md and judges it on the landed commit's own diff after requiring a single base parent; wrong, a skill or agent-definition *.md or a forged commit merges to main with no human.

Adds a fail-closed halt for a landed commit with an empty diff in the unattended-merge path, plus mutant M040 as evidence that out-of-allowlist commits are held; wrong, an empty commit closes an issue unattended or the allowlist hold loses its mutation evidence.

Runs unattended workers in a container holding one API key, lands their work with --no-hooks, narrows the docs allowlist and holds .github changes; wrong, worker-controlled code runs on the host with the owner's credentials, or a CI or code change merges to main unattended.
Clarifies the exact enqueue flags in one skill and two agent definitions; a wrong flag only makes an agent's enqueue fail, which the lander already refuses.

Integrates phases 3-4: the unattended issue-to-merge task loop, the loop, scope, budget and turn guards, the hook adapter and renderer, and rewrites of the lander, readonly guard and commit verifier; wrong, PRs merge to main without a person and agents run with broken allow/deny controls.
Test-only: adds denied-path cases and a --no-inputs scenario; new assertions cannot change what the harness copies or merges.

Force-deletes the worker container (which holds the API key) on timeout and Ctrl-C, names it by a hash of the worktree path, and records M053/M054 kills; a wrong name force-deletes another repository's running worker, and a missed delete leaves the key in a live VM.

Rebases eight stale mutant patches and adds a suite check that every patch applies to HEAD; a mis-rebased patch would mutate the wrong line and make later kill records for High paths misleading, and the new check can block every land.
Test-only: makes the socket and dirty-target setup portable and pins the enclosed-target refusal message; no production behaviour changes.

refuse_if_dirty now says 'not empty' for a directory inside an enclosing repository and 'status unreadable, inspect before removing' instead of calling it clean; every branch still refuses, so a wrong message could at most mislead a person into deleting uncommitted work.
